svg.title: A gold standard for dividing dense Loagaeth text
svg.text: A gold standard for dividing dense Loagaeth text
Peterson's index divides the unspaced lines into words — an independent check on word segmentation.
The nine unspaced 49-letter lines closing leaf 1b — ▼ Peterson's word breaks, ▲ our model's
Our word model (trained only on the spaced lines of leaf 1): F1 0.333 (precision 0.252, recall 0.491).
Random breaks, same number: F1 0.159 (95th pct 0.218); p < 0.0005. Teal ▲ = a break both agree on.
Peterson's breaks are an editor's reading (1986), not Dee's; the model over-cuts but finds his breaks twice as often as chance.
